out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: OBSERVED NO PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR SALMON OR TUNA WHICH MAY OFFERED UNDERCOOKED OR RAW. CONFIRMATION REQUIRED THAT TUNA SUPPLIED IS OF THE EXEMPT SPECIES.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REQUEST PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FROM SUPPLIER. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. STARRY NIGHT (Inspection Date: 03/31/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: DONKATSU SAUCE AT 46F AND FISH CAKES AT 45F IN BEVERAGE AIR 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE NOT STORED IN THAT REFRIGERATOR UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: OBSERVED NO CONSUMER ADVISORY ON ONLINE MENU FOR MENU ITEMS CONTAINING SALMON OR TUNA SERVED UNDERCOOKED OR RAW.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INDICATED MENU WAS BEING UPDATED. PLEASE SUBMIT UPDATED MENU TO EHS FOR REVIEW PRIOR TO POSTING BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: BEVERAGES STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE FOODS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: BEVERAGE AIR 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR AT 46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD TCS FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE NOT STORED IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW PORK, BEEF, SHRIMP KEBABS STORED OVER PREPARED VEGETABLES AND SAUCES IN BEVERAGE AIR 2 DOOR SLIDING UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: UTENSILS AND KITCHENWARE BEING WASHED AND RINSED FOR USE WITHOUT SANITIZING.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE TO EMPLOYEE IN SETTING UP THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK WITH SANITIZER SOLUTION FOR SANITIZING DISHES AFTER WASHING AND RINSING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MILK AT 46F, CORN AT 48F, SLICED CHEESE 47F, VARIOUS RAW MEAT KEBABS 46-48F IN BEVERAGE AIR 2 DOOR SLIDING UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING CONTAINERS OF SALT, SUGAR, SPICES, OILS AND SAUCES ON CART NEAR COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY LABELS TO ALL STORAGE CONTAINERS OF FOODS REMOVED FROM ORIGINAL PACKAGING. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer GARLIC CONTAINERS AND CANS were observed reused for the storage of SPICES, FLOUR AND BEAN SPROUTS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS ARE REMOVED FROM ALL MANUFACTURERS CONTAINERS AND CANS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: DISHWASHING MACHINE UNABLE TO DISPENSE SANITIZER DURING CYCLE. SANITIZER MEASURED 0PPM.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: OBSERVED NONE OF THE RAW ANIMAL PROTEIN ITEMS ON MENU FOR SASHIMI AND OTHER FOODS IDENTIFIED WITH ASTERISKS AS INDICATED WITH THE DISCLOSURE STATEMENT.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE ADDENDUM TO MENU TO IDENTIFY WITH ASTERISKS RAW OR UNDERCOOKED ANIMAL PROTEINS SERVED ON MENU WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: SPOONS IN CONTAINER NEAR COOK LINE IN WATER AT 70F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE DISCARDED WATER DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.
